summary: The authentic José Study V11 source cannot be recovered from currently durable evidence without inventing bytes. The workstream PACK/LAST_RETURN prove the pre-storage raw artifact was exactly 69,235 bytes with SHA-256 0cf9a40fb53e977dccb40c9755d668a3ee922ccd61883f19229bb4a113139a05, while the sole committed gzip+base64 payload is malformed. Repository history, the same-tree historical Prometeo export ZIP, linked José repositories, web search, and File Library were checked. A read-only GitHub Actions probe extracted the 5,858,174-byte historical export and SHA-256 checked every regular file: match_count=0. No decoder relaxation, payload guessing, authority-pointer mutation, Current/Human Accepted/Served promotion, or product-byte rewrite was performed.
